guard_streams.source: Pricing and consumer engagement 2025: interactive report
guard_streams.write_limit: Retail prices, switching behaviour, affordability and debt statistics are market context and cannot establish physical broadband availability at a parcel.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Pricing and consumer engagement 2025 report on 26 February 2026.
The report covers UK residential fixed-broadband pricing trends.
The report covers fixed-voice services.
The report covers mobile-phone services.
The report covers pay-TV services.
The report includes subscription video-on-demand services.
The report examines bundled and standalone service tariffs.
The report examines how much customers pay for communications services.
The report covers consumer engagement, switching, affordability and customer debt.
Ofcom provides an interactive report, a PDF report and a downloadable CSV dataset.

guard_streams.source: New Ofcom research reveals how to cut phone and internet bills
guard_streams.write_limit: National pricing, switching and affordability findings are not selected-parcel coverage, network availability or measured speed.

facts.detail: The research article was published on 26 February and updated on 30 June 2026.
Ofcom links shopping-around improvements to end-of-contract alerts, simpler contract summaries and easier switching.
Average advertised broadband prices across speeds fell by 6% in real terms.
Ofcom reports that 28% of broadband customers are out of contract.
Customers in contract spend about £7 to £9 less per month than out-of-contract customers on average.
Eighteen percent of households switched internet provider, up from 14% in 2023.
The One Touch Switch process had been used by more than two million customers.
Ofcom states that around eight in ten UK homes have access to full-fibre broadband.
Seventy percent of households buying broadband and landline together made no outgoing landline call.
Ofcom reports 532,000 social-tariff users in June 2025 while 70% of eligible households were unaware of the tariffs.
